Subject: Scheduling: coding screen with Priya Shah — staggered panel + live notes handoff

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for applying and for your flexibility. We'd like to schedule a focused coding/ML screen this coming Friday. Because of interviewer availability across timezones we plan to run a staggered panel (three short hands-on segments) rather than a single long slot. This keeps each session focused and lets us capture live notes between segments.

Proposed flow (Pacific time):
- Segment A (system design + quick coding): 10:30 — 11:15 PT
- Break / internal notes handoff: 11:15 — 11:25 PT
- Segment B (modeling prompt + evaluation): 11:25 — 12:10 PT
- Break / internal notes handoff: 12:10 — 12:20 PT
- Segment C (live coding problem): 12:20 — 13:05 PT

If that works for you we will send calendar invites for each segment. If you prefer a continuous 90-minute block we can accommodate but we need confirmation by EOD today.

A couple quick asks so we can prepare:
- Confirm timezone and whether you prefer Zoom or Google Meet.
- Can you use a browser-based coding environment (CoderPad)? If not, let us know.
- Please reply with an updated resume if we don't already have the latest.

Attached: panel-plan.pdf (one-pager for interviewers).

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Kimberly Park
Recruiting Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Thanks team — locking in the staggered flow. Operational decisions below so everyone has one place to look. I've also pushed calendar invites for the three segments to Priya and to all of you.

Ops decisions (final):
- Single CoderPad session will be used. We will create first problem in pad, then duplicate for segment C if needed. Link: https://coderpad.io/r/redwood/abcd-1234
- Host platform: candidate will join on Zoom (Priya preferred). Zoom link will be in calendar invites.
- Live note capture: Soojin will be primary note-taker in the shared Google Doc. Please paste a short rubric-based score after each segment (1-5) in the "Scores" table.
- Recording: request candidate consent before Segment A. If Priya declines, we will not record.
- Candidate materials: resume attached for easy reference.

Attachments: runbook-checklist.txt (short checklist for interviewers), inperson-instructions.pdf (parking and front-desk, not relevant for remote but attached for record).

Drive doc for notes: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1xExampleRunbook/view
Calendar master: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234staggered-panel

If anyone needs to swap segments, notify by 3pm PT today.
